title: Local-embedding Chroma RAG
limitations: Original stock-market PDF is available but not used: financial assertions and incomplete source references were not independently validated. Delivered PDF is an original three-page synthetic replacement.

DefaultEmbeddingFunction uses a real local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX model; initial download needs internet and local cache permissions. Offline tests do not download it or establish semantic retrieval quality.
Anthropic calls, optional tracing, rendering and execution screenshots are reserved for parent live validation. No live-call or dashboard pass is claimed here.
Top-k similarity does not establish answerability. Source/page validation proves provenance only, not semantic entailment or general prompt-injection resistance.

Persistent indexing is serial classroom ingestion, not a concurrent migration service. Re-index deliberately after model/package behavior changes; index fingerprint covers the source and declared configuration.
ReportLab is needed only to rebuild the supplied teaching PDF. The answer-card exercise uses deterministic retrieval routing rather than duplicating the demo's tool loop.
